extraction.topic: GOAL_WORLD.md Section 19 (Input Ownership / Virtual Joystick Regression)
extraction.notes: GOAL_ALFRED.md A-0807 regression scenario: a 'new control installed' claim must not be VERIFIED while the old owner is still mounted. This claim is the concrete instance already proven this session by tools/test-input-ownership.mjs, which asserts both halves (positive: new provider wired; negative: no other file mounts a competing stick-zone/stick-base/stick-knob/setupStick, and git history shows no prior joystick ever existed).

claims.normalized_claim: src/ui/touchControls.js is the sole active touch-movement and touch-look input provider; no other active input owner remains mounted.
claims.subject: touch input ownership

sources.speaker: GOAL_WORLD.md
sources.original_text: Es existiert exakt ein aktiver Touch-Movement-Provider. ... Alte .stick-zone, .stick-base, .stick-knob, setupStick() etc. duerfen nach Replacement nicht weiter mounten. ... Tests beweisen sowohl Existenz des neuen Controls als auch Abwesenheit des alten aktiven Owners.

evidence.details: Proves the positive half: src/ui/touchControls.js exports initTouchControls, main.js calls it exactly once, and setupStick (the actual zone/base/knob mount) is invoked exactly twice (move + look) from that single owner.

Proves the negative half GOAL_ALFRED.md A-0807 requires: walking every .js/.mjs/.ts file under src/, exactly one file (src/ui/touchControls.js) contains the stick-zone/stick-base/stick-knob/setupStick pattern -- no second, competing input owner is mounted anywhere else in the tree. This is the check that distinguishes 'new joystick installed' from 'new joystick installed AND old owner replaced', per A-0807's own wording.
